import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to;
        long rev;
        long capacity;
        long cost;
        long p;

        Edge(int to, long rev, long capacity, long cost, long p) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.p = p;
        }
    }

    static final int T = 99;
    static final long INF = 0x3f3f3f3fL;
    static final int C = 12;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int size = 50 * T + 2;
        ArrayList<Edge>[] adj = new ArrayList[size];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        // Helper method to add edges
        class Graph {
            void addEdge(int a, int b, long cap, long p) {
                adj[a].add(new Edge(b, adj[b].size(), cap, 0, p));
                adj[b].add(new Edge(a, adj[a].size() - 1, 0, 0, -p));
            }
        }

        Graph graph = new Graph();

        int source = 0;
        int sink = n * T + 1;

        // Read k nodes and connect from source
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            graph.addEdge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }

        // Build time layers
        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            graph.addEdge(1 + t * n, sink, INF, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    graph.addEdge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        // Read edges
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                int cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                    graph.addEdge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                    graph.addEdge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        // Min cost flow implementation
        class MinCostFlow {
            long[] dist = new long[size];
            long[] potential = new long[size];
            int[] parent = new int[size];
            int[] parentEdge = new int[size];
            boolean[] inQueue = new boolean[size];

            Pair<Long, Long> minCostFlow(int s, int t) {
                long flow = 0;
                long cost = 0;
                while (true) {
                    Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE);
                    dist[s] = 0;
                    Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
                    q.offer(s);
                    Arrays.fill(inQueue, false);
                    inQueue[s] = true;

                    while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                        int u = q.poll();
                        inQueue[u] = false;
                        for (int i = 0; i < adj[u].size(); i++) {
                            Edge e = adj[u].get(i);
                            if (e.capacity > 0 && dist[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[e.to] < dist[e.to]) {
                                dist[e.to] = dist[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[e.to];
                                parent[e.to] = u;
                                parentEdge[e.to] = i;
                                if (!inQueue[e.to]) {
                                    q.offer(e.to);
                                    inQueue[e.to] = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (dist[t] == Long.MAX_VALUE) break;

                    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                        if (dist[i] < Long.MAX_VALUE) {
                            potential[i] += dist[i];
                        }
                    }

                    long df = Long.MAX_VALUE;
                    for (int u = t; u != s; u = parent[u]) {
                        Edge e = adj[parent[u]].get(parentEdge[u]);
                        df = Math.min(df, e.capacity);
                    }

                    for (int u = t; u != s; u = parent[u]) {
                        Edge e = adj[parent[u]].get(parentEdge[u]);
                        e.capacity -= df;
                        Edge rev = adj[u].get(e.rev);
                        rev.capacity += df;
                        cost += df * e.cost;
                    }
                    flow += df;
                }
                return new Pair<>(flow, cost);
            }
        }

        MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow();
        Pair<Long, Long> result = mcf.minCostFlow(source, sink);
        long flow_value = result.first;
        long total_price = result.second;

        if (flow_value != k) {
            System.out.println(-1);
        } else {
            System.out.println(total_price);
        }
    }

    static class Pair<F, S> {
        public final F first;
        public final S second;

        Pair(F first, S second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }
}
